describe: A movement profile: how a character moves, as data (the character controller's settings it sets and the shooter model's numbers it changes, every other one Apex's), with a unit test that makes a character of it and measures its run, sprint and jump on the feel course against its own numbers (PLAN.md WP 13.3).
id: the module's path, labs/<lab>/movement/<name> (its id is movement:<name>; a character takes it with createCharacter({ movement: id })): labs/box/movement/heavy
next: make it move as its file comment says (a page's feel panel tunes it live, and its Copy as profile is the defineMovement call to paste); import {{id}}.ts where the character is made, createCharacter({ movement: 'movement:{{name}}' }); node x sim <scene> --feel prints what its player measures; then node x docs --write
